name: castreader
description: Build runnable speech features and generate playable audio with cost estimates and restartable jobs.

interface.longDescription: Add CastReader speech to a working application, or generate MP3 and WAV files from text. Includes a runnable local app, server-side key handling, live cost estimates, persisted jobs, recovery and audio receipts. API usage uses your CastReader Voice trial or wallet, separately from CastReader App Pro.
defaultPrompt: Add a working text-to-speech feature to my app.
Generate an MP3 from this text and show the cost.
Resume my interrupted CastReader audio job.
